senses.gloss: (corresp. to h. נָשָׂא a. נָטַל) to lift up; to take; to carry.
units: Targ. Gen. II, 21; a. fr.—נ׳ ויהב (= h. נשא ונתן) to deal.
Targ. Zech. V, 6, sq.—נ׳ (איתתא) to take to wife, marry.
Targ. Gen. IV, 19; a. fr.—נ׳ אפין (= h. נשא פנים) to be partial, favor.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 32:21">Targ. O. Gen. XXXII, 21</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 23:3">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 3</cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N00929"><he>נְסִיב</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="N00930"><he>נְסִיבָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00931"><he>נְסִיבְתָּא</he></cite>; pl. <he>נְסִיבִין</he>; <he>נְסִיבָן</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:23">Targ. O. Gen. II, 23</cite>.
Targ. Y. Num. V, 22 נסיבתא wedded.—נ׳ אפין respected.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:3">Targ. Is. III, 3</cite> (not <cite ref="N00929"><he>נְסֵב</he></cite>); a. fr.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ bot. <he>וחוא נָסֵיב כולא וכ׳</he> and he takes everything (entrusted to him) and runs away.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite>, beg. <he>דיִסַּב מאה וכ׳</he> that he should receive one hundred lashes; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 904">Yalk. Job 904</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 140">Yalk. Gen. 140</cite> <he>דיהיב</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>סַב מובלא וכ׳</he> take that load &c.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>סב לי טימיתהון וכ׳</he> take their price at my hands and carry them &c. Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ <he>נחות דרג וסב איתתא</he>; <cite ref="Yevamot 63a:10">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>נְסַיב איתתא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D01036"><he>דְּרַג</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Makkot 11a:16">Macc. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:8">Gen. R. s. 80</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00574"><he>גְּזַר</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 11b:15">Zeb. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>היא אַגְּרָרָהּ נַסְבָהּ</he> the redactor took this up (inserted it) by the way, v. <cite ref="C01397"><he>גְּרָרָא</he> II</cite>.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:2">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>והוה נ׳ נפש</he> and he took courage, felt better; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:2">ib.</cite> <he>ואיתנסיב נפש</he> read: <he>והוית נסיב נפש</he> and I felt better.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:2:7">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נ׳ לידוי</he> washed his hands (v. <cite ref="N00571"><he>נָטַל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:2:12">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נַסְבוּן ידיכון</he> (not <he>נסבין</he>) wash your hands; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:2:12">ib.</cite> <he>סב בריך</he> wash thy hands and say grace.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:3:2">Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>והוון סבין מיניה</he>, perh. to be read: <he>והוון נסבין</he>, they took from him.]

senses.gloss: , אֲסֵיב to cause to take, esp. to give in marriage to, to allow to marry.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 3:5">Targ. Zech. III, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 36:3">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVI, 3</cite> <he>דאֲסִיבָהּ</he> (not … <he>בא</he>); a. e.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:4">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>ואַנְסְבָהּ רב … לדביתהו</he> (not <he>ואנסבו</he>) and R. D. allowed his wife to marry again; <cite ref="Yevamot 121a:4">ib.</cite> <he>ואנסבוה</he> (corr. acc.).
Ib. 120ᵃ top לאַנְסוּבֵי לצרה וכ׳ (Rashi: לאִינְּס׳, Ithpe.) to permit her rival to marry before her.

Lev. R. s. 34 ואַסְּבוּן יתיה איתתא וכ׳ and they made him marry another wife; Yalk. Is. 352 אסביתיה, read: אַסַּב יתיה; a. fr.—[Sabb. 123ᵃ אַסּוּבֵי ינוקא to handle, treat the infant; v., however, אֲסַב.]

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105a:6">B. Mets. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>קא מְנַסְּבַת וכ׳</he> thou causest my land to bear a bad reputation. Yeb. l. c. <he>מְנַסְּבִינָן לה לצרה</he> we allow the rival to marry; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be taken; to be taken away; to be married.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 35:17">Targ. O. Num. XXXV, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 2:23">Targ. Y. Gen. II, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 17:2">Targ. Jud. XVII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 51a:15">Snh. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דאִינְּסִיבָא להו להני</he> because she is married to one of those.
<cite ref="Yevamot 120a">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite> (repeatedly) <cite ref="N00917"><he>אינסיב</he></cite> (read <he>אינסיבא</he>).
<cite ref="Yevamot 43b:6">Ib. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>אִינְּסוּבֵי הוא דלא וכ׳</he> to marry she is not allowed, but to be betrothed &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:2">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>איתנסיב</he>, v. supra.
